topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: Sure, I'd love to chat about the fence! I think it's a fantastic idea, actually. It can really add to the privacy and even boost the curb appeal of both our properties. I've been thinking lately that a little more defined space in the backyard could be just the thing for some of the gatherings I've been wanting to host. Plus, it seems like it could be a fun project to get involved with. I'm all for anything that brings a bit more green and personal touch to our little corner of the neighborhood. What do you think about maybe picking out some really nice fencing materials together? Can't wait to hear your thoughts!
